summary: Frontend-only regression for the new /gallery page (filters + lightbox) and navigation/logo/favicon. 24/25 checks passed. New Gallery route loads via direct URL and via navbar link, all 14 Unsplash images render (0 broken via naturalWidth check), category chips (football/tennis/cricket/nba/olympics/festival/travel/all) filter correctly and the active chip is amber-700. Lightbox opens on item click, next/prev change image, backdrop click closes. Favicon set, navbar logo (/favicon.png globe+plane) renders. Regression: navbar links to /, /events, /services, /about all navigate; Home hero-quote-btn routes to /contact; Contact form submit shows contact-success.

ui_bugs.issue: lightbox-close click did not remove [data-testid=gallery-lightbox] from DOM within 500ms in one automated pass, while clicking the backdrop (same setLightbox(null) handler) closed cleanly. Likely a test-timing flake around framer-motion's AnimatePresence exit animation rather than a functional bug — repeated manual verification recommended. Not reproduced on second interaction.

critical_code_review_comments: Contact.jsx select-event: React logs 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' hydration warning. Emergent's visual editor is injecting a wrapping <span data-ve-dynamic> inside <option> elements produced from the EVENTS array map. This is a tooling/instrumentation artifact and does not break submit (contact-success shown), but produces console noise. Non-blocking for this iteration.
